services.title: Site visit / inspection
services.description: A visit from your adviser to inspect the site, check compliance and catch issues early.

services.title: Specialist assessment (noise/LEV)
services.description: Specialist monitoring such as noise exposure and LEV (dust/fume extraction) examination and testing.

services.title: COSHH assessment
services.description: Assessment of hazardous substances in use, with the controls needed to protect your people.

services.title: General risk assessment
services.description: Task- or area-based risk assessments identifying the hazards and the controls to manage them.

services.title: DSE assessment pp
services.description: Display-screen workstation assessments to prevent discomfort and musculoskeletal injury for office staff.

services.title: Policy & document review
services.description: We review and refresh your H&S policy and supporting documents to keep them current and compliant for up to 20 documents.

services.title: RAMS review
services.description: Expert review of your risk assessments and method statements before work starts on site up to 20 documents.

services.title: Accident / incident investigation
services.description: Root-cause investigation after an accident or near-miss, with corrective actions and RIDDOR reporting guidance/instruction.

services.title: Management review meeting
services.description: A structured review of your H&S performance, open actions and priorities with your adviser.

services.title: H&S consultancy
services.description: Ad-hoc advice from your named adviser on any health & safety question as it comes up.

services.title: CDM / contractor support
services.description: Support meeting your CDM duties on construction projects — client duties, principal contractor coordination and documentation.

services.title: Emergency First Aid at Work (1 Day) pp
services.description: Emergency First Aid at Work (EFAW) training with DEFIB with Qualsafe accreditation

services.description: First Aid at Work 3 day training including Defib, resuscitation, recovery, bandages, choking, asthma, anaphylactic shock. Qualsafe accreditation certificate

services.description: Accredited H&S training delivered to your staff, counted in trainer person-days. This is for general training (Manual Handling, Fire Awareness, Work at Height, Abrasive Wheel, Asbestos). IIRSM Certified

services.description: Short, focused safety briefings delivered to your team on a specific topic or risk.

services.title: Toolbox Talk 52 weeks
services.description: A full years worth of weekly toolbox talks with additional tbt's included along with blank template for ad hoc spot tbt's
